ROGUE — moves with calculated silence, eyes always measuring exits and shadows, fingers flexing with restless anticipation of the next mark.
SORCERESS — stands with chin raised, arcane energy crackling faintly at her fingertips, the air around her shimmering with barely contained elemental power.
PALADIN — posture rigid with unwavering conviction, radiant authority emanating from her presence, every gesture deliberating righteous purpose and divine mandate.
RANGER — scans horizons with wind-honed vigilance, movements economical and terrain-tested, bearing the patient watchfulness of one who reads nature's subtle warnings.
BARBARIAN — shoulders squared with primal intensity, stance wide and grounded, raw kinetic energy coiled beneath barely restrained fury waiting to erupt.
CLERIC — moves with serene deliberation, divine light flickering softly around her hands, exuding calm reassurance that comes from channeling sacred power.
DRUID — carries herself with wild unpredictability, eyes reflecting ancient forests, her presence somehow both grounded and untamed as shifting seasons.
NECROMANCER — stands unnervingly still, pale ethereal wisps curling at her shoulders, gaze distant as though communing with voices beyond mortal hearing.
BARD — gestures with theatrical flourish, every movement deliberately captivating, voice carrying enchantment that makes strangers lean closer despite themselves.
MONK — poised in perfect balance, breathing measured and centered, radiating disciplined tranquility that masks devastating precision waiting beneath stillness.
WARLOCK — holds herself with unsettling confidence, eldritch symbols occasionally flickering across her skin, bearing the weight of bargains made in darkness.
ARTIFICER — posture bent with inventive focus, fingertips stained with arcane reagents, eyes bright with mechanical inspiration and experimental determination.
KNIGHT — spine straight with martial discipline, presence commanding immediate respect, every step deliberate with the gravity of sworn oaths honored.
SHAMAN — sways slightly as if hearing distant rhythms, spirit-smoke drifting around her frame, eyes glazed with visions from the otherworld.
ARCANIST — regards surroundings with analytical detachment, faint geometric patterns glowing momentarily in the air, posture reflecting intellectual superiority and theoretical mastery.
WARRIOR — stands battle-ready with feet planted firm, movements efficient and combat-tested, bearing scars of experience with pride rather than shame.
ASSASSIN — melts into peripheral vision, heartbeat slowed to predatory calm, every micro-movement calculated to avoid detection until the fatal moment.
WITCH — hunches slightly over arcane workings, muttering incantations under her breath, fingers weaving complex patterns through herb-scented smoke and shadow.
INQUISITOR — observes with piercing scrutiny that peels away deception, posture inflexible with doctrinal certainty, presence demanding confession through sheer judgmental weight.
BATTLE-MAGE — crackles with volatile magical energy, stance aggressive and forward-leaning, merging martial readiness with devastating arcane potential in perfect synthesis.
TEMPLAR — moves with zealous purpose, divine fire burning in her gaze, presence radiating both protective devotion and the capacity for holy violence.
ELEMENTALIST — surrounded by swirling manifestations of primal forces, posture shifting like flame or water, eyes reflecting whichever element currently holds sway.
MYSTIC — walks as though partially elsewhere, consciousness split between material and astral planes, movements dreamlike yet purposeful with esoteric knowledge.
CHAMPION — carries herself with earned glory, stance open and fearless, exuding the magnetic confidence of one accustomed to triumph and adoration.
SAGE — observes with ancient patience beyond her years, fingertips occasionally tracing remembered runes in empty air, bearing accumulated wisdom like a mantle.
